title: DriveGen on an iPhone: the app grid, the map, a demo drive, a command's card
tryitout: On DriveGen (iPhone): a command's screen pops up as a card

steps.why: DriveGen in Chrome as an iPhone

steps.js: openView('home'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 600)); return document.querySelectorAll('.app-tile').length
Peek.tapAt = Date.now(); openView('maps'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 2500)); return current
startNav({ name: 'Cubbon Park', lat: 12.9763, lon: 77.5929 }); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 8000)); return !!nav && !!nav.route
steps.why: Start a demo drive to Cubbon Park

steps.js: openView('agent'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 500)); handleCommand('open weather'); await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 4000)); return { current, peek: !!document.querySelector('.peek, #peekCard:not([hidden])') }
